title: Starr County (TX) webjail — offences record (one charge)
description: One charge row from GET /offences (envelope {total,limit,skip,data:[...]}). The same objects are embedded in GET /inmate-detail/<ptsBookingID> under .offences. Join to inmates via ptsBookingID.

_id.description: Mongo ObjectId. GET /offences/<_id> is NOT a working lookup (404).

ptsBookingID.description: Join key to the inmates record for the same stay.

StatuteDescription.description: Free-text statute, uppercase and heavily abbreviated, e.g. POSS MARIJ >4OZ<=5LBS, CAPIAS (FREE TEXT IN NOTES), OUT OF COUNTY WARRANT. Never parse this into a code.

StatuteLevel.description: Messy in practice: MA, MB, F1, F2, F3, SF, plus the county typo "MISDEMEANO" and null (~40% of a recent sample). Treat as an opaque label.

BondAmount.description: US dollars; null when unset. F1 charges can carry 1,000,000. 0 means no bond set, not "free" — check IsBondDenied too.

IsBondDenied.description: Per-charge bond denial. All false in recent snapshots, but the field is authoritative when set.

ArrestingAgency.description: e.g. STARR COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE (note the apostrophe), RIO GRANDE CITY POLICE DEPARTMENT, TEXAS DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY, ROMA POLICE DEPARTMENT, HIDTA; null on some warrant rows.

ArrestDate.description: UTC midnight, date-only; null on some rows (e.g. warrants).

createdAt.description: Same hourly batch semantics as inmates.

updatedAt.description: Re-stamped hourly; not a change signal.
